a mixed blessing..ex: Working from home is a mixed blessing: I save commuting time, but I miss my coworkers.

the last word on the subject..ex: This new handbook is considered the last word on the subject of urban gardening.
the last word on the subject..pt: Este novo manual é considerado a palavra final sobre o tema da jardinagem urbana.
the last word on the subject..tip: Também: “have the last word” = dar a palavra final.

worth the price alone..ex: The view from the rooftop bar is worth the price alone, even if the drinks are expensive.
worth the price alone..pt: A vista do bar na cobertura vale só pelo preço, mesmo que as bebidas sejam caras.

fall short of expectations..ex: Sadly, the new phone fell short of expectations, especially its battery life.
fall short of expectations..pt: Infelizmente, o celular novo ficou abaixo das expectativas, principalmente a bateria.

is the statement true or not given?.ex: “Is the statement true or not given?” “Not given. The passage never says who built the bridge.”
is the statement true or not given?.pt: “A afirmação é verdadeira ou não informada?” “Não informada. O texto nunca diz quem construiu a ponte.”

and “all examples come from large firms”.ex: “And ‘all examples come from large firms’?” “False. Two of the examples are small family businesses.”

leave someone out in the cold..ex: The team made the decision without telling Maria, which left her out in the cold.
leave someone out in the cold..pt: A equipe tomou a decisão sem avisar Maria, o que a deixou de fora.

be kept in the dark..tip: Forma passiva: be kept in the dark about something.

adjourn the session..pt: O juiz decidiu encerrar a sessão até segunda de manhã porque uma testemunha estava doente.

walk out of the talks..ex: The union threatened to walk out of the talks if wages weren’t discussed.
walk out of the talks..pt: O sindicato ameaçou abandonar as negociações se os salários não fossem discutidos.

break the deadlock..ex: Only a compromise from both sides can break the deadlock in the budget debate.
break the deadlock..pt: Só um acordo entre os dois lados pode quebrar o impasse no debate do orçamento.

why is reyes angry in this scene?.ex: “Why is Reyes angry in this scene?” “Because his brother lied to him about the money.”
why is reyes angry in this scene?.pt: “Por que Reyes está zangado nesta cena?” “Porque o irmão mentiu para ele sobre o dinheiro.”

having been left out of the planning, he.ex: Having been left out of the planning, he feels disrespected and refuses to attend the launch.
having been left out of the planning, he.pt: Tendo sido deixado de fora do planejamento, ele se sente desrespeitado e se recusa a ir ao lançamento.
having been left out of the planning, he.tip: Having been + particípio: ação anterior, voz passiva.

say the line again, and lean on “left ou.ex: “Say the line again, and lean on ‘left out’. That’s where the pain is.”
say the line again, and lean on “left ou.pt: “Diga a fala de novo e enfatize ‘left out’. É aí que está a dor.”
say the line again, and lean on “left ou.tip: Lean on = dar ênfase a uma palavra.

i am inclined to agree..ex: After reading the report, I am inclined to agree with your proposal to delay the launch.
i am inclined to agree..pt: Depois de ler o relatório, tendo a concordar com sua proposta de adiar o lançamento.

lean towards a view..ex: Most economists lean towards a view that interest rates will stay high this year.
lean towards a view..pt: A maioria dos economistas tende a ter a visão de que os juros continuarão altos este ano.

sit on the fence..ex: Stop sitting on the fence and tell us which restaurant you actually prefer.
sit on the fence..pt: Pare de ficar em cima do muro e diga qual restaurante você realmente prefere.

are we inclined to support the plan?.ex: “Are we inclined to support the plan, or do we need more data first?”

what condition?.ex: “You can borrow my car, on one condition.” “What condition?” “Fill up the tank.”
what condition?.pt: “Pode pegar meu carro, com uma condição.” “Qual condição?” “Encha o tanque.”

it must include practice, not only lectu.ex: A good teacher-training course must include practice, not only lectures.
it must include practice, not only lectu.pt: Um bom curso de formação de professores deve incluir prática, não apenas palestras.

little is known about….ex: Little is known about the deep ocean, since most of it has never been explored.
little is known about….pt: Pouco se sabe sobre o oceano profundo, já que a maior parte nunca foi explorada.

the findings suggest that….ex: The findings suggest that students who sleep eight hours score noticeably higher on exams.

further research is needed..ex: The pilot results are promising, but further research is needed before we change the policy.
further research is needed..pt: Os resultados do piloto são promissores, mas mais pesquisas são necessárias antes de mudarmos a política.

fill a gap in the literature..ex: Our survey aims to fill a gap in the literature on remote teaching in rural schools.
fill a gap in the literature..pt: Nossa pesquisa pretende preencher uma lacuna na literatura sobre ensino remoto em escolas rurais.

in line with previous studies,….ex: In line with previous studies, we found that regular reading improves vocabulary in teenagers.

to the best of our knowledge,….pt: Até onde sabemos, nenhum estudo anterior testou este método com adultos iniciantes.

what did the study find about silence?.ex: “What did the study find about silence?” “That pauses make listeners remember more of the talk.”

why is training suggested?.ex: “Why is training suggested?” “Because new staff made fewer mistakes after a short workshop.”
why is training suggested?.pt: “Por que se sugere treinamento?” “Porque os novos funcionários cometeram menos erros após uma oficina curta.”

because briefed participants interrupted.ex: The session ran smoothly because briefed participants interrupted less than the untrained group.
because briefed participants interrupted.pt: A sessão correu bem porque os participantes instruídos interromperam menos que o grupo sem treinamento.

just over half.ex: Just over half of the voters stayed home during the local election last spring.
just over half.pt: Um pouco mais da metade dos eleitores ficou em casa na eleição local da primavera passada.
just over half.tip: Usado para descrever gráficos e estatísticas.

a significant minority.ex: A significant minority of commuters still prefer driving despite the new train line.
a significant minority.pt: Uma minoria significativa dos passageiros ainda prefere dirigir apesar da nova linha de trem.

roughly one in five.ex: Roughly one in five teenagers in the survey said they never read for pleasure.

the vast majority.ex: The vast majority of customers were happy with the new delivery system.

stand out from the rest.ex: Her essay stood out from the rest because of its clear, honest voice.
stand out from the rest.pt: A redação dela se destacou das demais pela voz clara e honesta.

lag behind.ex: Rural areas still lag behind cities in access to high-speed internet.
lag behind.pt: As áreas rurais ainda ficam atrás das cidades no acesso à internet de alta velocidade.

how should we begin the description?.ex: “How should we begin the description of this bar chart?” “With a general overview.”

highlight the key figures and make compa.ex: When you describe a graph, highlight the key figures and make comparisons between groups.
highlight the key figures and make compa.pt: Ao descrever um gráfico, destaque os números principais e faça comparações entre os grupos.

the rule of thumb is….ex: The rule of thumb is to save at least ten percent of whatever you earn.

get the wrong end of the stick..ex: I think you got the wrong end of the stick; he wasn’t criticizing you at all.

get the wrong end of the stick..tip: Expressão mais britânica, mas compreendida nos EUA.

a fine line between….ex: There is a fine line between being confident and sounding arrogant in interviews.

a fine line between….tip: Estrutura: a fine line between X and Y.

as a general rule,….ex: As a general rule, I don’t answer work emails after seven in the evening.

by the same token,….ex: Praise can motivate people; by the same token, constant criticism can crush their confidence.

and being asked?.ex: “I know ‘having asked’, but what about ‘having been asked’?” “And being asked? That is the passive form.”

so which is passive: having read or havi.ex: “So which is passive: having read or having been read?” “The second one.”

having been read is passive. the subject.ex: “Having been read is passive. The subject receives the action, it doesn’t do it.”
having been read is passive. the subject.pt: “Having been read é passiva. O sujeito recebe a ação, não a pratica.”

be that as it may….ex: Be that as it may, we still have to finish the report by Friday.
be that as it may….pt: Seja como for, ainda temos que terminar o relatório até sexta.
be that as it may….tip: Concede um ponto e passa para outro.

in spite of this,….ex: The road was icy. In spite of this, the bus arrived on time.

that said,….ex: The food was delicious. That said, the service was painfully slow.
that said,….pt: A comida estava deliciosa. Dito isso, o atendimento foi dolorosamente lento.

even so,….ex: It rained all weekend. Even so, we had a great time camping.
even so,….pt: Choveu o fim de semana todo. Mesmo assim, nos divertimos muito acampando.

how do you summarize this article?.ex: “How do you summarize this article in one sentence?” “Apps help, but they can’t replace teachers.”

good. add a contrast marker..ex: “Good. Add a contrast marker like ‘however’ to link the two ideas.”

apps help students, but they still miss.ex: Apps help students, but they still miss tone and body language in real conversations.
apps help students, but they still miss.pt: Aplicativos ajudam estudantes, mas ainda perdem o tom e a linguagem corporal em conversas reais.

against all odds,….ex: Against all odds, the tiny village team won the national championship.

rise through the ranks..ex: He started as a cleaner and rose through the ranks to become the hotel’s manager.

find one’s voice..pt: Depois de anos copiando outros, a jovem escritora finalmente encontrou a própria voz.

having been rejected, how did you contin.ex: “Having been rejected by ten publishers, how did you continue?” “I just kept writing.”
having been rejected, how did you contin.pt: “Tendo sido rejeitada por dez editoras, como você continuou?” “Simplesmente continuei escrevendo.”

what is your secret?.ex: “You run a marathon every month. What is your secret?” “Sleep and patience.”
what is your secret?.pt: “Você corre uma maratona por mês. Qual é o seu segredo?” “Sono e paciência.”

having been told no once, i trained at n.ex: Having been told no once, I trained at night until the coach finally noticed me.
having been told no once, i trained at n.pt: Tendo ouvido não uma vez, treinei à noite até o técnico finalmente me notar.

smooth things over..ex: After the argument, she brought coffee to smooth things over with her roommate.

meet someone halfway..ex: If you lower your price a little, I’ll meet you halfway on the delivery date.

on the same wavelength..ex: We’re on the same wavelength, so we finish each other’s sentences at work.
on the same wavelength..pt: Estamos em sintonia, então terminamos as frases um do outro no trabalho.

what do we need to iron out?.ex: “What do we need to iron out before the contract is ready?” “Just the payment terms.”
what do we need to iron out?.pt: “O que precisamos resolver antes de o contrato ficar pronto?” “Só as condições de pagamento.”

the difference between “maybe” and “no”..ex: In some cultures, learning the difference between “maybe” and “no” takes years of practice.

can we iron it out today?.ex: “There’s still a small disagreement over the budget. Can we iron it out today?”

go round in circles..ex: We’ve been going round in circles for an hour without making any real decision.

waste someone’s time..ex: Please don’t waste my time with excuses; I need the numbers by noon.

put it bluntly,….ex: To put it bluntly, the project is three months late and over budget.
put it bluntly,….pt: Falando sem rodeios, o projeto está três meses atrasado e acima do orçamento.

leave nothing to chance..ex: Before the big presentation, she rehearsed twice to leave nothing to chance.
leave nothing to chance..pt: Antes da grande apresentação, ela ensaiou duas vezes para não deixar nada ao acaso.

what does the cartoon show?.ex: “What does the cartoon show?” “Two people on opposite sides of a river, both shouting.”
what does the cartoon show?.pt: “O que a charge mostra?” “Duas pessoas em lados opostos de um rio, ambas gritando.”

what is the cartoonist’s message?.ex: “What is the cartoonist’s message?” “That we hear a lot but rarely listen.”

that vague answers waste time..ex: The cartoon suggests that vague answers waste time and frustrate everyone involved.

thank you for your consideration..ex: Thank you for your consideration; I look forward to hearing from you about the position.

should i mention the outline?.ex: “Should I mention the outline of my thesis in the email?” “Yes, briefly.”

how should i plan my email to the profes.ex: “How should I plan my email to the professor?” “Greeting, purpose, details, thanks.”

give rise to doubts..ex: His sudden change of story gave rise to doubts about whether he was telling the truth.

what if he refuses?.ex: “We’ll offer him the job.” “What if he refuses?” “Then we call the next candidate.”
